annotations.title: Which curated gurus hold this ticker

description: Returns every guru from our 60-name roster who held the requested ticker as of the latest 13F-HR quarter (or a specific historical quarter). Each row includes shares, USD value, % of portfolio, and the auto-classified delta vs the prior quarter. (GET https://app.deepvalues.ai/api/v1/smart-money/holdings — 0.005 credits per call; works with no credentials up to 25 call(s)/day per address)
